description: v4 only. Aave v4 hubs: a hub holds the liquidity and global accounting that user-facing spokes draw from. Returns each hub's hubId, address, chain and totals. Pass a hubId to get_hub_assets for the assets it carries. Omit chainId to cover every supported v4 chain.

chainId.description: Chain id to restrict to, e.g. 1 for Ethereum. Omit the argument entirely to cover every chain.

version.description: Optional, and only 'v4': this tool exists on v4 only.

name: get_hubs
title: Get v4 hubs
